text: Eating a balanced diet is the foundation of a healthy life. This means including plenty of fruits, vegetables, whole grains, and lean proteins in your meals, while limiting processed foods and sugar. Alongside good nutrition, regular exercise—even a daily thirty-minute walk—keeps your body strong and your heart healthy. However, physical health is only part of the picture. Getting enough sleep, ideally seven to nine hours a night, is crucial for your brain to rest and recharge. Equally important is your mental health, so try to manage stress through relaxation or hobbies. Finally, aim for a healthy work-life balance by setting boundaries and making time for family and fun. When you care for both your body and mind, you feel more energized and positive every day.
